recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to the Measure terminology content should be made through THO/UTG unless a later FHIR-core tracker changes Measure or MeasureReport binding locations or strengths.
issue_request: FHIR-39623 was Applied/Persuasive by CQI for R6. It requested comparing Measure-family code systems against THO, adding missing THO concepts if needed, removing duplicated CodeSystem resources from base FHIR, and leaving the Measure terminology referenced through THO.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-39623 was found. The requested effect was applied through adjacent cleanup commits: a3768d9df82b8b5b5b7bedfbe08618ea365d9b2f removed the duplicate Measure-family CodeSystem resources other than measure-scoring, and 2f8cd92164241ce4bf26d720de3207f4b0593251 removed measure-scoring and changed Measure binding URLs to terminology.hl7.org value sets.
additional_context: The active fhir.ini includes Measure, and current source has no active fhir.ini entries or source definition files for the listed core CodeSystem/ValueSet resources. Measure and MeasureReport bindings now use extensible terminology.hl7.org value sets. A contemporaneous Zulip thread records the duplicate-terminology cleanup rationale and Bryn Rhodes stating the Measure code systems would be migrated together and verified. UP-173 and UP-278 explain THO-side composite/retired-code context without creating a remaining FHIR-core change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already satisfies the issue. No source edit is needed in the FHIR core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Implemented the THO-side movement of the composite code from Measure Type to Measure Scoring, explaining part of the current THO content referenced by FHIR bindings.
Withdrawn proposal to exclude retired MeasureType codes from the value set expansion; it does not require a current FHIR-core source change.
